statement: let w := fun (X : ℕ) => (Finset.range (2*X+1)).filter (fun n => X < n ∧ 50*n < 51*X); let primes := fun X => (w X).filter Nat.Prime; let c := fun (d : ℕ) => -(ArithmeticFunction.moebius d : ℝ)*Real.log d; let long := fun (X D : ℕ) => (primes X).sum (fun p => Real.log p * (((p+2).divisors.filter (fun d => D < d)).sum c))/(X:ℝ); let D := fun (X : ℕ) => Nat.floor ((X:ℝ)^(1/3:ℝ)); let f := fun (p : ℕ) => if p.Prime ∧ 2 < p then 1-1/((p:ℝ)-1)^2 else 1; let twinC := ∏' p : ℕ, f p; ∃ κ : ℝ, 0 < κ ∧ ∀ B : ℕ, ∃ X : ℕ, B < X ∧ -2*twinC/50 + κ < long X (D X)
